title: Lipschitz Bound for Fourier Coefficients via Mathlib LipschitzWith API

problemStatement.plain: The gallery entry `fourier-series-oq-02-incomplete-01` establishes infrastructure for Fourier coefficient decay under Hölder conditions, but leaves `fourier_lipschitz_bound` as a sorry. This problem asks whether Mathlib's `LipschitzWith` API — which provides a structured interface for Lipschitz maps — can be used to give a clean Lean 4 proof of the bound, closing the sorry.
